title: In 1954, a Meteorite Crashed Through a Roof and Hit a Woman on Her Sofa

scenes.text: In 1954, a meteorite crashed through a roof and hit a sleeping woman.
Alabama, 2:46 in the afternoon. A fireball was seen across three states.
An eight and a half pound space rock punched through the ceiling, hit a radio, and slammed into her hip.
She woke up badly bruised. The only person ever confirmed hit by a meteorite.
Then her landlady claimed the rock was hers. They settled for 500 dollars.
The family used it as a doorstop. Today it's in a museum.

description:
On November 30, 1954, an 8.5 pound meteorite crashed through the roof of a house in Sylacauga, Alabama, bounced off a radio and struck a woman asleep on her sofa, leaving a huge bruise on her hip.
The fireball was seen across Alabama, Georgia and Mississippi. She remains the only person known to have been injured by a direct meteorite hit; her landlady claimed the rock and settled for 500 dollars, and the meteorite is now in the Alabama Museum of Natural History.
What would you do with a rock that fell from space into your living room?
thumbnail_text: HIT BY A METEORITE. ON HER SOFA.
first_comment: A second piece of the same meteorite landed a few miles away and is now in the Smithsonian. Would you keep a space rock that fell on you, or sell it?
